extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia editors / contributors (users attempting to create an article)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance/notice shown when a requested Wikipedia article does not exist, directing users on creating or finding alternative pages. The fetched page is the 'page does not exist' stub, not substantive content about the requested topic.
extracted.error: Wikipedia page does not exist / article-not-found stub (no substantive rubric content)
